title: Bounded relay JSON body
responsibility: Reads a bounded JSON object while rejecting unsupported public content types and oversized bodies.

inputs.name: readJsonBody.request
inputs.description: Request supplying headers and a byte stream.

inputs.name: readJsonBody.typed
inputs.description: Optional content-type requirement, defaulting to true. False skips only the application/json check for internal callers.

outputs.name: readJsonBody
outputs.description: Promise resolving to a non-null JSON object, or undefined for a missing body, wrong content type, declared/actual body over 16 KiB, malformed JSON or non-object result. Reads chunks incrementally and cancels at the first byte above the limit.
